case_title: Padal Venkata Rama Reddy @ Ramu v. Kowuri Satyanarayana Reddy and Ors.
neutral_facts: The accused, who were part of a political rivalry, conspired to assault the victim. The accused hired individuals to attack the victim, causing grievous injuries. The victim and his wife provided statements detailing the incident and the involvement of the accused. The prosecution filed a chargesheet against multiple accused, but the High Court quashed the proceedings, leading to the Supreme Court's review.
